channel_overview.creator_background: Polish AI game developer building a commercial stylized survival game set in the Polish Beskids mountains for Steam alongside his brother (who runs the companion channel 'AI Dev Challenge'), while running rigorous head-to-head AI coding & 3D game-building benchmarks.

core_engines_and_3d_pipeline.name: Godot Engine 4.x (with Jolt Physics)
core_engines_and_3d_pipeline.role: Primary game engine across 95% of videos
core_engines_and_3d_pipeline.workflow_notes: Agents edit plain-text .tscn, .gd, and .gdshader files directly without an MCP server. Uses Godot Jolt physics for shatterable glass, destructible shelves, and 1,700-beam BeamNG vehicle destruction, plus MultiMesh for 1,600-unit armies and forest foliage.

core_engines_and_3d_pipeline.name: Blender (Headless Python Scripting + Gauntlet Loop)
core_engines_and_3d_pipeline.role: Procedural 3D modeling, UV unwrapping, decimation, rigging & animation retargeting
core_engines_and_3d_pipeline.workflow_notes: Instead of interactive Blender MCP clicking, AI agents write standalone Python scripts executed via headless Blender CLI. Uses the 'Gauntlet Loop': a Builder Agent generates the mesh, renders multi-angle previews, an independent Critic Agent inspects the renders against the reference image + Color Bible, and a numeric validator checks exact bounding-box dimensions.

core_engines_and_3d_pipeline.name: Unreal Engine 5
core_engines_and_3d_pipeline.role: Used in latest monster/Griffin animation showcase & early horror tests
core_engines_and_3d_pipeline.workflow_notes: Used to test the retargeted Griffin locomotion/takeoff/flight animations in 'I Tested 9 AI Video Models for Game Animation. Most Failed'.

ai_3d_and_animation_tools.name: Tripo 3D (Smart Mesh 2.0 / P2.0 & Tripo CLI)
ai_3d_and_animation_tools.role: AI 3D asset & character generation from multi-view orthographic drawings
ai_3d_and_animation_tools.workflow_notes: Best results achieved by having GPT-6 Astra draw front + side + mirrored-side orthographic views on a dark background, generating quad-topology meshes in Tripo P2.0, unwrapping with Smart UV, and repacking into shared Texture Atlases. Automated via Tripo CLI with single-submission credit locks.

ai_3d_and_animation_tools.name: NVIDIA Kimodo (Open-Source Text-to-Motion)
ai_3d_and_animation_tools.role: Free humanoid character animation generation from single-sentence prompts & path constraints
ai_3d_and_animation_tools.workflow_notes: Trained on 700+ hours of real optical mocap. Exports BVH and NPZ bone rotations. Retargeted to custom Mixamo/Tripo rigs via a 5-step Blender Python script (<3° bone error).

ai_3d_and_animation_tools.name: Custom 2-Camera AI Video Motion Capture Pipeline (UniRig + Meta DINO + Seedance/MiniMax/Wan/Kling)
ai_3d_and_animation_tools.role: Animating arbitrary non-humanoid monsters (Griffin, Troll, Lizard, Wraith, Deer, Bear, Hare, Pheasant)
ai_3d_and_animation_tools.workflow_notes: 1) Auto-rig 3D model with UniRig + geometric symmetry validator; 2) Render 3,000 synthetic blurred poses from front+side cameras to fine-tune Meta DINO (30 mins on GPU); 3) Render front+side composite frame of monster and animate in Seedance 2.0/2.5 or MiniMax on Higgsfield; 4) Triangulate 2D DINO joint detections into 3D bone rotations.

ai_3d_and_animation_tools.name: Meshy AI
ai_3d_and_animation_tools.role: Character & Uruk-hai 3D mesh generation with polycount control
ai_3d_and_animation_tools.workflow_notes: Used in 'Stop Asking AI To Build The Whole Game At Once' (8k poly snow survivor) and 'I Asked Two AIs to Rebuild Helm's Deep' (<4k poly Uruk-hai).

ai_3d_and_animation_tools.name: CMU Motion Capture Database & Adobe Mixamo
ai_3d_and_animation_tools.workflow_notes: Used for log-carrying shoulder animations, archery retargeting, and harbor character locomotion.

ai_3d_and_animation_tools.name: Tezana AI (Prompt-to-Godot Prototype Generator)
ai_3d_and_animation_tools.role: Sponsored benchmark comparison against custom Opus 5 workflow
ai_3d_and_animation_tools.workflow_notes: Generates playable Godot prototypes in 20–30 minutes and exports full Godot projects for local agent continuation.

ai_coding_models_benchmarked.name: Claude Opus 5.5 / Opus 5 / Sonnet 5.5 / Fable 5.1 / Fable 5 (via Claude Code in VS Code)
ai_coding_models_benchmarked.role: Primary orchestrator, GDScript mechanics engineer, and headless Blender coder
ai_coding_models_benchmarked.workflow_notes: Consistently top-ranked on complex physics (1,700-beam BeamNG car destruction, shallow-water river solver, snow physics, custom DINO animation tool) and atmospheric lighting.

ai_coding_models_benchmarked.name: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra / GPT-6.1 Sol / GPT-5.6 Sol (via Codex CLI / VS Code Extension)
ai_coding_models_benchmarked.role: Concept art / orthographic reference generator, texture synthesis, and co-developer on the Steam survival game
ai_coding_models_benchmarked.workflow_notes: GPT-6 Astra excels at generating front/side orthographic reference sheets, seamless concrete/tile textures, and long-session building mechanics (floor/wall/window axe-cutting).

ai_coding_models_benchmarked.name: Kimi K3, Grok 4.5, GLM
ai_coding_models_benchmarked.role: Benchmarked in multi-model elimination tournaments and classic game rebuilds
ai_coding_models_benchmarked.workflow_notes: Kimi K3 noted for strong visual aesthetics at 5x lower API cost than Opus 5, though weaker on complex 3D physics.
